faqs.question: Does “Specifications” add a cell to fine stone concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. ACI Committee 304’s *Guide to Placing Concrete by Pumping Methods* (ACI 304.2R-17) limits angular coarse aggregate to one-third of the smallest inside diameter of the pump or pipeline, and well-rounded aggregate to two-fifths of that diameter.
